validation_method: Static metadata and path checks plus a fresh-context agent following an inert entry/skills fixture at the same directory depth and running doctor read-only.

doctor_environment.status_scope: Required Python modules only; this is not complete OCR or delivery readiness.

remaining_user_environment_checks: Open the latest repository version in Codex and confirm the project skill is listed or explicitly loaded.
Run doctor using the Python environment that will process the documents.
For Traditional Chinese scans, confirm both chi_tra and eng OCR language data are available.
Perform a non-sensitive document trial and review the rendered output before using real engineering documents.
